items.title: Google Antigravity rolls out Dynamic Workflows for deterministic agent orchestration
facts: We're rolling out Dynamic Workflows in Google Antigravity.
Use /run-workflow and the agent writes a Python script to orchestrate parallel and sequential subagents with structured handoffs, giving you deterministic control flow instead of prompt drift.
Review the script before it runs, and save it to re-run the same flow anytime.

items.title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday coding and agentic workflows
facts: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced flat across its entire 1 million-token context window at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
Hydrogen finishes tasks 2.5 times faster at its high default setting while more than tripling Terminal-Bench 4.1 scores (57% vs. 18.2%).

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.323 adds experimental Code Mode for JavaScript tool calls
facts: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization
Code Mode is experimental and off until a user turns it on, and an organization can turn it off for everyone.

items.title: OpenCode 2.3.0 makes subagents run in the background by default
facts: Subagents now return immediately, continue in the background, and report back whenever they become idle.
You can keep working in the parent session while multiple subagents run concurrently.

items.title: Codex 0.168.0 adds model-provider browser and side conversation in TUI
facts: Browse model providers under Sessions → Model providers and choose the default for new chats.
Enable features.tui_workspace to view a side conversation beside the main chat.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app adds general availability for GitHub Enterprise Server accounts
facts: You can now bring your work on GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) into the GitHub Copilot app.
Add your GHES account to work with remote repositories, issues, and pull requests.
Available in GitHub Copilot app 1.2.0 and later. Cloud sessions aren’t available for GHES.

items.title: AWS Emulator GA built entirely by agents, with public fidelity scores
facts: AWS just shipped a local emulator for its whole API surface, and no human at AWS wrote or reviewed a single line of it.
It's called AWS Emulator, it went GA on Nov 11, it's written in Rust, it's free, and the source is on GitHub under CC0.

items.title: Developers share and discuss open agent skill packs and configs for Claude Code and others
facts: THIS IS A GOLDMINE FOR ANYONE USING CLAUDE CODE. Stop building your AI coding workflow from scratch.

Some of the biggest names in AI development, including Anthropic, Garry Tan, Addy Osmani and other experienced builders, have released their actual AI agent configurations on GitHub for anyone to use.
